messages:
Alex: quick note: after last night's kernel roll (fused-attn-v2) a few streaming-chat pools show p99 spikes starting ~11:05Z. p50/p95 look fine so far.
Maria: saw the alert too. p99 up ~150-220ms on several hosts. grabbing profiler dumps.
Cheng: do we know if KV policy changed? sounds like cache behavior could amplify tails.
infra-bot: deploy: fused-attn-v2 rolled to prod at 2026-03-16T11:05:22Z by @deploy-bot
Maria: profiler snapshot from host-12 (sampling window 60s):
```text
kernel: fused-attn-v2
avg_exec: 1.1ms
exec_tail: 7.4ms
microbatch_size: 4
kv_hit_rate: 76%
batching_latency: 20ms
net_wait: 2.8ms
```
Sam: my quick read: kernel exec tail + queuing variance from mb=4. streaming chat has many short sequences, so per-request variance shows up in p99.
Denise: we didn't change KV eviction policy in deploy. kernel scheduling differences can change cache line residency though.
Alex: Maria, can you run a tiny canary with mb=2 for streaming-chat? want to see p99 difference.
Maria: spun up canary pool (25% traffic) with mb=2. first 30m: baseline (mb=4) vs canary (mb=2):
```text
baseline mb=4: p50=21ms p95=92ms p99=305ms
canary mb=2: p50=24ms p95=98ms p99=185ms
```
Maria: so median slightly worse, p95 small reg, p99 much improved. throughput ~ -5% on canary nodes.
Cheng: classic: smaller microbatches reduce queueing amplification -> better tail, but per-token overhead rises.
Sam: also noticed one host with large io_wait spikes due to storage GC around the same time:
```text
2026-03-16T11:12:03Z host-12 storage_gc paused io 28ms
```
Alex: so multi-factor: kernel variance, IO jitter, mb sizing. we need an actionable plan.
Denise: suggestion: route streaming-chat to a pool with mb=1-2 and prefer fallback kernel legacy-attn until we fix fused-attn-v2 variance. we already support per-route configs but need autoscaler tweaks.
Maria: prototyped per-route rule in staging:
```json
{"route":"/v1/chat/stream","microbatch_size":2,"kernel_preference":["fused-attn-v2","legacy-attn"]}
```
Cheng: important to measure KV hit-rate by route+seq_len since smaller mb changes interleaving and can reduce prefix reuse. add histogram by route.
Sam: implemented an early-flush idea: for streaming, dispatch first token immediately (early_flush_threshold=1) then batch subsequent tokens. saw first-byte p99 improve ~30ms in staging.
Alex: nice. can we run AB tests to quantify tradeoffs?
Maria: scheduling a 6h AB with three cohorts: baseline mb=4, mb=2, and mb=1 with early_flush. traffic split 25/25/50. will collect latency CDFs, kv-hit hist, kernel exec dist.
Denise: infra: please capture io_wait traces, kernel tail histograms, and --dump-kv-stats=true in profiler. set sampling cadence to 5m.
Sam: I'll wire up a tail-analyzer that computes p50/p95/p99 and tail-mass (>p95). will post plots here.
Cheng: also add a lightweight regression check to fail canaries if p99 increases >50ms without throughput win.
Maria: interim 1h AB results: mb=2 reduced p99 by ~110ms vs mb=4, throughput -6%. mb=1+early_flush reduced p99 by ~150ms, throughput -12%.
Alex: good. timeline to complete 6h run and analysis? want a decision by EOD tomorrow.
Denise: will open a perf ticket to dive into fused-attn-v2 exec variance (possible scheduling/kern-level fix).
Maria: will post CDF plots and KV hit-rate deltas after full run. so far kv_hit_rate dropped ~2-4% on mb=1 pools for short prefixes.
Sam: note: for non-streaming completions we should keep larger mb (8-12) since they benefit from batching and tolerate small added latency.
Alex: solid. next steps recap:
- Run full 6h AB (Maria)
- Infra capture kv/io/kernel histograms (Denise)
- Eng-runtime: add per-route mb presets + autoscaler guardrails (Cheng)
- Sam: tail analyzer + publish plots
- Denise: perf ticket for fused-attn-v2 variance
Alex: thanks all. please drop logs, CDFs, and any anomalous host ids here. we'll iterate on fallback/routing if needed. :thumbsup:
